name: web-frosted-card-management-dashboard-on-light-monitor
title: Frosted Card Management Dashboard
whatItIs: A pale monitor showing a grey frosted banking dashboard with a tile sidebar, KPI strip with sparklines, a fan of pearlescent cards with a large platinum card, dotted and striped bar charts, spending categories and card utilisation.
whatItMeans: Pearl, grey and black keep a data-heavy page calm, and the platinum card is a clear focal point.
techniques: Card fan with one large card in front
Dot-matrix bars and stripe bars as chart textures
Black active tile in the sidebar
Pro upsell card at the base of the sidebar

vocabulary.definition: A tiny line chart shown beside a figure.
A bar made of tiny dots.
A card promoting a paid upgrade.
